reference.method: Direct native UI inspection using a task-created Arc Help Center tab

observed.singleClick: Opens Peek centered over the browser window while Library and the Archive row remain visible.
observed.close: Dismisses Peek; Library, search query, and the archived entry remain.
observed.expand: Converts the preview into the foreground tab, closes Library, and removes the chosen Archive entry.
observed.searchFocus: Opening the row leaves the Archive search field focused.
observed.escapeWithSearchFocus: Closes Library while leaving Peek open; a second Escape dismisses Peek.
observed.rowRightClick: No context menu appeared in two direct right-click checks of the task-owned row.

regressionRequirements: Keep archived back/forward history and container isolation.
Preserve the live document and navigation when expanding.
Keep normal and private Archive records separate.
Only consume a record after successful adoption.
Retain the existing Boosts preview without an Expand control.
remaining: Archive row sizing, hover visuals, accessories and context-menu reconciliation.
Check modified clicks, navigation shortcuts, and other interactions inside Peek.
